links.outcome: Expert-panel review of GPT-4 cardiovascular scenarios for clinical accuracy and guideline adherence
links.effect: All five experts found the scenarios realistic and guideline-consistent, but they also documented specific errors, incorrect recommendations, missing information, and inconsistencies with standard nursing practice.
links.quote: All the experts agreed that the scenarios were realistic and followed clinical guidelines.

unlisted_practices: Expert review and refinement of AI-generated educational simulation scenarios before use in teaching

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality and realism of clinical simulation scenarios generated by ChatGPT (GPT-4) via qualitative expert review, noting the need for expert verification.
